fusions.name: Order to Fire
fusions.desc: Fires a shot that deals 32 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health to the first enemy it meets.

fusions.name: Deafening Crack
fusions.desc: A blast across a cone 5 tiles long that deals 12 damage to everything in it and stuns each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Volley on My Word
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 20% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Echoing Report
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a shot strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
